settings.heading: Authentic Mayan Handcrafts from Lake Atitlán
settings.text: Handmade jewelry, backstrap-loomed tote bags, and embroidered home decor. Every purchase provides living wages directly to over 120 indigenous weavers and funds youth scholarships in Guatemala.
settings.caption: Passing down generations of weaving knowledge in the Guatemalan highlands

settings.title: Featured Artisan Crafts
settings.description: Handcrafted by indigenous master weavers in Sololá & Santiago Atitlán.

settings.name: Elena Quiej
settings.bio: Elena is a master of plant-based natural dyes, weaving organic cotton threads on a traditional backstrap loom passed down through five generations.

settings.name: María Xuncax
settings.bio: Specialist in hand embroidery and glass beadwork who recounts Mayan cosmology and local fauna through every intricate stitch.

settings.name: Rosa Chonay
settings.bio: Renowned textile artisan and co-founder of our women's weaving cooperative, championing financial independence and scholarships for indigenous girls.

settings.title: Meet the Hands Behind the Weaving
settings.subtitle: Every thread woven and every bead strung carries the identity, pride, and generational knowledge of indigenous Maya women.
